definition: Relating to the arteries that feed the heart muscle. Chest pain is still the commonest heart attack symptom in women, but breathlessness, nausea and jaw or back pain are more common than in men. Wear Red Day.
One bone of the spine; plural vertebrae. You have seven in your neck, the same number as a giraffe.
The feeling of being short of breath. Spelt with an O here; the Americans lost theirs somewhere on the stairs.
Skin cancer of the pigment cells (melanocytes). Australia and New Zealand have the highest rates in the world. New or changing spot? Get it checked.
